subject: CPS portable export writer v2.5 (cps-export-writer-portable.v2.5), saved_qa v4 (cps-export-saved-qa.v4), visual_qa v2
decision: ADMITTED for CPS qualification evidence under the conditions below (owner decision O5: build a portable writer; four independent review rounds)
reviews: round 4 (v2.5): ADMIT, no blocking finding; notes N1-N4
conditions_of_use: 1 Required runs: saved QA with --carrier = the frozen route carrier (expected_provenance.carrier_sha256 checked against ADAPTER_RECEIPT.json carrier_sha256 or the freeze record, and the check recorded), --writer-dir, without --no-formatting; status SAVED_ALL_CELL_VALUE_TYPE_PASS, expected_provenance.result PASS, receipt_claims.match true, cps_evidence_preconditions.all_checked_here_met true.

2 Checker node: run from a clean shell independent of the producer, with --checker-node /opt/node22/bin/node --checker-node-sha256 2286ce92...f7ff; never taken from the producer receipt, --node or PATH; checker_node.realpath, sha256 and sha256_after_check must match, and the same file must appear in writer004_check_node (v1 receipts) and rerun_node. Any other node binary needs a new admission entry.

3 Tools: before the run the operator checks the sha256 of saved_qa.py, writer_portable.py, writer004_matrices.mjs and visual_qa.py against files_sha256; the saved-QA record must show the listed writer_portable.py and writer004_matrices.mjs hashes.
4 Writer directory and versions: pinned files as regular files in the writer directory; the checker --writer-dir holds the same writer004.mjs pin as the producer; openpyxl 3.1.5.

5 Receipt: only the compared fields count (mode, relaxations without route_v4_port.path, cross_check, expected_saved_values, matrices_sha256, sheets, writer, writer_files, status, admitted); v2 relaxation classes and documented cells come from expected_provenance.rerun_relaxation_classes and rerun_documented_cells. Until review note N1 is fixed, a WRITER_RECEIPT.json with duplicate JSON keys is not evidence: the run harness rejects it before saved QA.

6 Mode v2 only for carriers whose convert receipt says export_mode_required v2 and policy_checks applied; reported as writer004 on the placeholder copy plus the documented cells; M/N facts are R48 policy checks. Saved QA establishes saved-cell fidelity to writer004 intended matrices only (L2-L5 are not artifact-tool fidelity; nothing about source semantics or Excel display).

7 Visual QA: never re-save the workbook; a separate reviewer checks every PNG against the 9-item README checklist; the manifest limits apply; the visual-QA manifest saved_xlsx.sha256 must equal the xlsx.sha256 in the evidence-grade SAVED_QA.json (review note N2).
8 This record is the admission; the README NOT ADMITTED line is superseded by this file for the hashes listed.

open_notes.N1: duplicate JSON keys in WRITER_RECEIPT.json accepted by saved_qa (harness check until fixed)
open_notes.N2: zip entry raw name vs normalised name not rejected (caught by provenance; condition 7)
open_notes.N3: saved_qa does not verify its own tool hashes (condition 3)
